generation.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create one professional original independent website-proposal logo. Horizontal logo for LIGHT website surfaces, with clear dark/charcoal foreground lettering, legible name hierarchy, large useful symbol if present, generous counters and crisp edges. Genuine alpha transparency. A polished final logo, not a poster or mockup. No extra text, fake checkerboard, background rectangle, watermark, shadows, fake chrome, gradients or texture. No tiny slogan, no misspelled words. Prefer a balanced landscape lockup that remains readable at 240px wide, framed close to the artwork with a small transparent margin. One logo only. This output is a proposed website asset, not a claim of dealer adoption.

Create the matching light-ink variant for DARK website surfaces of the supplied C-Car Sales Ltd logo. Preserve exact wording, spelling, symbol, composition, typography, spacing and proportions. Change dark name/foreground elements to clean solid white; preserve recognizable genuine source accents where they remain clear against #111113 and deep red. Transparent alpha background; no background block, mockup, texture, distressed edges, new decorations or extra text. This must remain the same logo, simply its readable on-dark counterpart. Exact text: C-CAR SALES LTD. Whole design with enough clear transparent margin.
